errors.what: first quadrature test had the likelihood exponent wrong (p^3.5 for two wins plus half a tie); the module was right, the test was fixed to p^2.5

doc_friction.issue: The empirical-Bayes section's pooled-Gaussian pairwise coverage (staged 0.926) was measured on seed base 1000 only; on seed base 50000 one staged cell's pooled sd collapses to 0.33 (coverage 0.39), so that figure overstated the pooled prior's reliability. Recorded in the new section.
The diagnosis 'a Gaussian prior on uniform truth over-shrinks the extreme items' was untested; the ends-vs-rest gap is only 0.01-0.04, so most of the shortfall is elsewhere.

goal: Land a slice of flagship 8's next milestone
notes: Student-t prior option (priorDf) in btRefit.ts refit, sampled evidence and pooled search, with 12 tests against closed forms, numerical integration, finite differences and quadrature. Sweep (scripts/t-prior-interval-sweep.ts): 108 honest + 108 careless cells (3 truths x 2 seed bases x 8/15/30 items x 2/4/8 answers x 2 selectors). Every heavier tail covers less than the Gaussian of the same evidence, under uniform, normal and Laplace truth; evidence picks the Gaussian in 90/108 honest cells. Not shipped; flagships.yaml next rewritten. Verification: npm run typecheck ok; eslint on changed files ok; npm run test:fast 447 passed; btRefit.simulation.test.ts passed.
